unit_statements_verbatim: Admission to the minor is only available to students who have completed 4 units of prerequisites (BISC 120 or BISC 121 ) as part of their major requirements.
Upon completion of 20 units and graduation, the minor is noted on the student’s transcript.

notes.text: The science, health and aging minor is appropriate for students working toward careers in medicine, dentistry, pharmacy, biological sciences, public health or other health related fields.
